answer: A newcomer proves one identity with a jetty dredging certificate: its dredge number, channel depth, and engineer signature are filed with the copper dredge desk and checked against the delta channel registry in an hour. The copper desk matches certificate and channel. A certificate reused under another name fails, and the person is barred for a cycle, forfeiting 430 units. An honest newcomer pays 430 units once; a thousand fakes pay 430,000. A farm reusing one run for a thousand clones fails: one run clears one channel, so one certificate binds to one channel.
